selected_reason: Fastest evaluated config that satisfies the accuracy gate on trace-verified decode. Decode is dominated by the already-BFP4 routed-expert matmuls, so every lower-precision/lower-fidelity move on the remaining (smaller) groups left token-out decode inside a +/-0.7% measurement-noise band (29.98-30.38 t/s/u) while several cost top-1 (attn->BFP4 0.94, LM-head->BFP4 0.93, all-HiFi2 0.92). Baseline has the best accuracy (top1 0.95, top5 1.00, top100 1.00), sits at the fastest tier on BOTH the mandated teacher-forcing metric and the tight token-out metric, and is the simplest/safest per the skill's noise tie-break. No lower-precision config passed FASTER, so the baseline is kept.
consumed_by: LagunaModel.from_pretrained loads this file's 'policy' block by default via load_selected_precision_policy() (TT_LAGUNA_PRECISION_CONFIG env overrides the path); build_generator and the vLLM adapter therefore construct exactly this weight/activation/CCL/KV/compute-fidelity policy. Consumption is verified field-by-field (built policy == this policy).

layer_exceptions.layer_0: dense SwiGLU MLP (no experts): dense_ff13/dense_ff2 = BFP8 (there is no BFP4 expert group in layer 0)
layer_exceptions.layers_1_39: EP-sharded routed MoE (256 experts partitioned across the mesh: 128/device on p150x2 and 64/device on p150x4, top-8) with BFP4 experts + BFP8 shared expert
layer_exceptions.attention_and_norms: uniform across all 40 layers (no per-layer dtype exception)
layer_exceptions.terminal: LM head BFP8 (column-sharded), final RMSNorm BF16/HiFi4 — not a decoder layer

compute_fidelities.lm_head: LoFi (fixed; fastest fidelity, _lm_ck=_ck_lofi in model.py; C10 is the BFP4+LoFi lm-head candidate)
compute_fidelities.note: RMSNorm + SDPA fidelities are fixed precise (HiFi4) for long-context accuracy and are NOT swept. LM-head fidelity is fixed LoFi (already the fastest).

ccl_dtype.note: 2 ring all_reduce/layer; BFP8 CCL swept (C8) and rejected (batch-1 payload is one row, typecast overhead made it slightly slower: 29.98 vs 30.33 t/s/u; no accuracy change).

kv_cache_dtype.note: prefill fill tensors cast to BFP8 before paged_fill_cache; decode paged_update_cache inputs stay BF16 (dest BFP8). BF16 KV swept (C1): identical accuracy 0.95 and speed, 2x the memory -> BFP8 kept. Production serving is qualified at 131072 tokens; the experimental 262144-token probe was rejected on latency (see ../context_contract.json).

logits_sampling_dtype.sampling: Sampling1D greedy top-k(k=1); k uint32, p/temp bfloat16; all-gather of only the D x 32 candidate value/index set (NOT the 100352-wide vocab); on-device token feedback into tt_out_tok. Production p150x2 uses D=2; experimental compact argmax remains default-off because it was slower.

safe_baseline_override: This selected config IS the safe baseline. A more conservative policy (e.g. BF16 KV, HiFi2 projections, BF16 attention weights) can be built by writing a different JSON here or passing precision_config_path=/precision_policy= to build_generator / LagunaModel.from_pretrained, or TT_LAGUNA_PRECISION_CONFIG=<path>.
hardware: Precision sweep captured on p150x4: 4 Blackhole P150 ASICs in a 1x4 mesh, FABRIC_1D_RING, KMD 2.10.0, fw 19.11.0
